defensives.name: Cloak of Shadows
defensives.usage_rule: Use it to shed a dangerous magic effect or to walk through a heavy magic hit.

defensives.name: Evasion
defensives.usage_rule: Use it for heavy incoming melee or physical damage you cannot avoid.

defensives.name: Crimson Vial
defensives.usage_rule: Press it to top off health whenever you take chip damage, since its short cooldown lets you use it often.

defensives.name: Feint
defensives.usage_rule: Press it ahead of a raid-wide or AoE hit for the area damage reduction.
